general.q: Who can apply through this portal?
general.a: Anyone with a valid CNIC and a Pakistani mobile number can create an account. Each job lists its own eligibility rules: education, age, domicile and documents.

general.q: Is there a fee to register?
general.a: No. Creating an account is free. Some jobs have an application fee, shown on the job page.

general.q: How do I find jobs for my qualification?
general.a: Open Available Jobs and filter by scale (BPS), department, location or education, or search by job title.

general.q: Are jobs on this portal official?
general.a: Yes. Every job is approved by Pakistan Railways before it is published, and each carries its advertisement number.

applications.q: Do I need to complete my whole profile before applying?
applications.a: No. When you apply, the portal checks the job's requirements and asks only for what is missing for that job.

applications.q: Can I edit or withdraw an application after submitting?
applications.a: No. Submitted applications are final. Check the review page carefully before you submit.

applications.q: How do I track my application?
applications.a: Log in and open My applications. Each application shows its status and a timeline of every change.
From the date of birth in your profile, on the job's closing date (or the cutoff date in the advertisement, if there is one). You never enter your age.

account.q: How do I create an account?
account.a: Choose Register, enter your CNIC and mobile number, and type the 6-digit code we send by SMS. Your permanent profile is created straight away.
No. You log in with your CNIC and the mobile number you registered, and we send a new code by SMS every time.

account.q: I didn't receive the SMS code.
account.a: Wait a minute and use "Resend code". Check that the number is the one you registered. After 5 codes in an hour, wait before trying again.

account.q: Can I register a second account?
account.a: No. Each CNIC can have only one account, which you keep for every future job.
